dct_description_sm: "Lambert conformal conic projection based on standard parallels 33⁰ and 45⁰."

"Lambert conformal conic projection based on standard parallels 33⁰ and 45⁰." Relief shown by spot heights. "Base map drainage modified 1974." Base map "Compiled 1957, revised 1973." Includes text and table of hydrologic units. Scale 1:500,000; 1 in. equals approx. 8 miles. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. AACR2
